test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the word that is INCORRECTLY spelt in the given sentence.**

Traditional people are used to using a calender for their routine activities in rural households.
solution:
The correct answer is "Calender."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word** "Calender" **is used incorrectly.
 
• **"Calender"** means a machine in which cloth or paper is pressed by rollers to glaze or smooth it. (एक मशीन जिसमें कपड़े या कागज को चमकाने या चिकना करने के लिए रोलर्स द्वारा दबाया जाता है)
 
 
• **Example**: *After printing, the paper passes through a **calender**__ to enhance its smoothness and finish.*
 
 
 
• **"Calender" **must be rep
